definitions.explanation: The number of characters—kanji, kana, letters, and so on—in a piece of text. Most often used when there is a length limit, as in forms, essays, social media posts, and documents.

examples.japanese: {文字数|もじすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧。
examples.english: to count the number of characters.

examples.japanese: ⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文字数|もじすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The report has a character limit.

examples.japanese: ⟦ツイート→ツイート：11043_tsuiito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文字数|もじすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{限|かぎ}られている→限る：02033_kagiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{言|い}いたい→言う：00515_iu⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{短|みじか}く→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: Tweets have a limited character count, so I summarized what I wanted to say briefly.

notes:
Combines ⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧ (character, letter) + ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number, count). Refers to how many characters a piece of text contains, usually in the context of a length limit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文字数|もじすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧: to count the characters
- {文字数|もじすう}⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧: character limit
- {文字数|もじすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: to have many characters (be long)
- {文字数|もじすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦オーバー→オーバー：01529_oobaa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exceed the character count
